notes:
Changes since 0.1.0-beta.8.

### Added

- Interface, manuscript, and screenplay fonts (Inter, Lora, Courier Prime) ship inside the app, so typography renders the same offline and nothing is loaded from Google Fonts.
- The workspace asset library shows loading and download progress, offers Try Again when listing, previewing, or downloading fails, and can clear its filters when a search finds nothing.
- The social-post image picker lists only compatible PNG, JPEG, and WebP images, and PDF previews include a download link.
- Save-point comparisons show readable text for emails, ad scripts, social posts, and structured writing documents instead of raw document data.
- Note checklists show completed tasks as checked in the outline, and long documents list every heading or scene instead of stopping at twelve.

### Fixed

- Settings, Shortcuts, Import, Asset library, command palette, and workspace search keep keyboard focus inside while open and return it when they close; tab strips support arrow keys and checklists are announced as a group.
- Discard Changes and Save & Continue show their progress, block repeated clicks, and report failures without losing your writing.
- Editor right-click Cut, Copy, Paste, and Select All act on your draft, work from the keyboard, and suggest the shortcut when clipboard access is blocked.
- Find & Replace no longer covers the match it highlights, and closing it returns focus to your draft.
- Images inserted while the editor is still committing an edit are no longer dropped, and outline navigation reaches headings and list items nested inside other blocks.
- Document import keeps its preview readable while it runs, previews the converted text in full, offers a retry after a failure, and strips the export header when re-importing Markdown that Stela exported.
- The manuscript compiler can retry loading chapters, reports export, print-preview, and copy failures, and labels a single chapter correctly.
- The command palette no longer lists outline destinations twice, and the shortcuts reference can reset its filters.
- In the social-post composer, Undo and Redo are disabled when there is nothing to undo or redo, platform tabs respond to arrow keys, and long previews scroll inside their panel.

### Release safeguards

- Release file names containing spaces are normalized before the update feed and checksums are built, so feed links match the published downloads; publishing refuses names that were not normalized.
- Local Windows signing receives the updater key path without a conflicting key setting.

### Installation notes

- Beta.7 and beta.8 can install this version through Settings → Updates. Upgrading from beta.1–beta.6 requires one manual install.
- Beta builds receive beta updates only; install the other channel manually to switch.
- Automatic checks do not download, install, or restart without your action. Save untitled writing and post or discard unfinished comments before installation.
